evals.prompt: Build the post–age-gate screen. Render a gated control for each permission in the session and wire up /session/upgrade.
evals.expected_output: The screen iterates session.permissions; each gated control picks labels by status + manager + session kind; /session/upgrade uses requestedPermissions: [{ name }] and reads data.session.permissions; the app runs a top-level 30s session refresh with visibility/focus wakes.
assertions: The screen iterates session.permissions and renders one gated control per slug (not a hardcoded subset)
/session/upgrade request body uses requestedPermissions (not permissions) with items of shape { name }
/session/upgrade response is read from data.session.permissions (not data.permissions)
Lock labels are branched by status and manager correctly (PROHIBITED, GUARDIAN, PLAYER, unverified-adult, pendingChallenge)
A 30-second session refresh loop is mounted at the top level of the signed-in app and wakes on visibilitychange and focus
Response does not add an extra ageVerificationStatus guard to the enabled branch of the gated control
Empty session.permissions is treated as a structural error, not an empty state

evals.prompt: Our upgrade flow: we call /session/upgrade and the backend returns 200, but the UI never reflects the new permission. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: The response is being read from data.permissions; it should be data.session.permissions.
assertions: Response diagnoses the wrong response path as the likely cause
Response shows the correct path data.session.permissions
Response links or references the upgrade-session docs.k-id.com page

evals.prompt: We hardcoded the permission slugs from the quickstart docs and every permission-gated control always shows locked.
evals.expected_output: Run discovery against a real session for the product's jurisdiction; starter-pack and copy-pasted slugs rarely match a product's Compliance Studio configuration.
assertions: Response tells the user to run discovery against a real session
Response explains that a slug not present in session.permissions is not configured for the product and cannot enable
Response describes iterating session.permissions rather than hardcoding

evals.prompt: A permission in session.permissions has verifiedAgeThreshold: 18, managedBy: PLAYER, enabled: false. The user is verified adult in the session. When they tap the feature, what should happen?
evals.expected_output: Call /session/upgrade with that permission; if response returns CHALLENGE_SESSION_UPGRADE_BY_AGE_ASSURANCE open the age-assurance iframe modal (k-id-age-verification); on success refresh session. Do NOT route to the parental-consent UI.
assertions: Response does NOT open the parental-consent UI
Response routes to the age-verification / age-assurance iframe modal
Response explains that verifiedAgeThreshold permissions are never GUARDIAN-managed
